title: artistmanager
tagline: Every artist should have a manager. Bringing AI-powered managers to every independent musican
description: We are building a tool for artists by artists. Independent artists already wear too many hats. Let's take some off by democratizing artist management. But instead of taking a percentage, it creates them and distributes them to your supporters/fans/community. Effortlessly creating and managing tokens, onchain media, content storage, content distribution, engagement, social media insights and accountability and more.
how_its_made:
I built this project using CDP AgentKit, Cursor and a few ElizaOS packages to help with telegram bot integration, social integrations and database integration. 

CDP agentkit gave me a great base / boilerplate for then customizing and building an ai agent for music management. Base gave me a great foundation for integrating wallet functions/ token capabilities into the agent as well. 

I stayed up until 7am one night to code the bulk of the project! And then spent the next few days testing and working out the details. 

It’s made from own experiences being an artist with the functions that I know artists and independent creators struggle with and could use help with. A lot of us seek managers but if you’re small it’s very hard to find someone who is reliable and willing to work with you and who sees your vision/goals and truly believes in them. So we end up doing everything ourselves and becoming our own bottlenecks. So really, I built this from my own problems and frustrations and found a way to piece together different methods and technologies to build this.
